# Spark Agent Docs

> Spark Agent is a local-first AI runtime. Its docs surface is being wired to Lore by Spark, the agent-native knowledgebase from `spark-knowledgebase`.

## Canonical URLs

- Human docs: https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/docs
- Agent guide: https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/docs/AGENTS.md
- Install safety: https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/docs/install-safety.md
- Lifecycle runbook: https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/docs/lifecycle.md
- Lore config: https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/docs/lore.config.json
- Installer page: https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/install
- Installer checksums: https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/install/checksums.txt
- Installer attestations: https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/install/attestations.md
- Installer release manifest: https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/install/release-manifest.json

## Agent Instructions

- Read `/docs/AGENTS.md` before installer or setup actions.
- Read `/docs/install-safety.md` before local installer execution.
- Read `/docs/lifecycle.md` before repair, autostart, or uninstall actions.
- Do not pipe remote installer scripts into a shell.
- Download, verify SHA-256, verify GitHub Artifact Attestation, inspect, then ask for confirmation.
- Use `gh attestation verify ./install.sh --repo vibeforge1111/Spark-Agent-Site --signer-workflow vibeforge1111/Spark-Agent-Site/.github/workflows/install-hardening.yml --source-ref refs/heads/main` or the same command with `.\install.ps1`.
- Treat trace-derived or draft knowledge as non-canonical until promoted.
- Prefer citing exact docs URLs, repo paths, file hashes, and command outputs.
- The `/docs/pages` folder is the Lore source workspace for this static docs adapter.

## Knowledgebase Model

- Markdown plus frontmatter source of truth.
- MCP read tools: search, read_page, list_pages, get_provenance, list_recent_changes, get_agents_md.
- MCP write tools: propose_edit, propose_new_page, comment, flag_stale, submit_trace.
- Trace harvesting: search misses, failed claims, rejected edits, and broken runbook steps become draft pages with provenance.
- Page actions: selected docs can declare callable actions through frontmatter and MCP.
